text: Derived (p.1): The game is a repeating two-phase loop (Phase I player dice allocation, Phase II machine phase) that ends only in a win (Doom Core destroyed) or a loss (player destroyed).
Derived (p.1): The player's dice pool ranges from 5 dice (5 black) up to 10 dice (5 black + 5 yellow), and all available dice are re-rolled at the start of each turn.
